question: The central idea of the passage is that:

options.text: scientific theories can be formulated only in quarantine
some great works have come out of quarantine
quarantine makes one ill and inactive

solution:
The correct answer is "**some great works have come out of quarantine**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **theme **of the passage is about how quarantine and isolation are not necessarily punishments as the time spent in quarantine can be used productively. Scholars such as** Isaac Newton, Charles Darwin, John Milton, and Lord Byron** have produced a considerable amount of work during this time.
 
• Quarantine and isolation are where one is free from the distractions of professional duties, has time for reflection, and spends time with family

**Hence, the correct answer is option 2**
